# Third party code

Unmodified copies of other projects that this project is used together with. They are **not** part of this repository's
Gradle build; build each one from its own folder.

| Folder | Project | Upstream commit | Licence | Source |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [`viarewind/`](viarewind) | ViaRewind (lets 1.8 clients join 1.9+ servers) | `f6424dd` | GPL-3.0-or-later | https://github.com/ViaVersion/ViaRewind |

Each folder keeps its own `LICENSE` and source headers. They are separate works under their own copyright; see
[THIRD_PARTY.md](../THIRD_PARTY.md). To update a copy, replace the folder with a newer upstream checkout and update the
commit above.
